data.long_meaning: The name Jahdal is derived from the Hebrew language and means 'God's descendant'. In the context of the Bible, this name is often given to those who are chosen by God to lead His people.

For those who bear this name, it is a constant reminder to walk in the footsteps of God and to serve as a role model and leader for others in their spiritual journey.
